_verification.note: Drug #4, CNS/psychiatry stress test. Claude-drafted from web sources; human spot-check pending. Approximate dates (first-in-human ~2020, Phase 1b readout ~2021) and PANSS values to confirm; AD-psychosis Phase 1 NCT to confirm. Story: Phase 1b positive → Phase 2 EMPOWER-1/-2 failed to replicate (Nov 2024). Sponsorship transferred Cerevel → AbbVie (acquisition closed Aug 2024), captured via per-trial sponsor arrays. NEW finding: the timeline event-type enum has no home for corporate events like an acquisition — see docs/roadmap.md.

trials.name: Phase 1b (CVL-231)
trials.note: Positive: statistically significant PANSS reduction vs placebo (Nature Medicine 2022). The signal that later failed to replicate in Phase 2.

trials.name: EMPOWER-1 (Phase 2)
trials.note: Initiated by Cerevel; AbbVie at readout (acquisition closed Aug 2024). Missed primary PANSS endpoint at week 6 (10 mg / 30 mg; only slight improvement vs placebo).

trials.name: EMPOWER-2 (Phase 2)
trials.note: Initiated by Cerevel; AbbVie at readout. Missed primary PANSS endpoint at week 6 (15 mg / 30 mg; low dose worsened symptoms vs placebo).

trials.name: Phase 1, Alzheimer's disease psychosis
trials.note: Separate indication, still running under AbbVie after the schizophrenia Phase 2 failure. No efficacy readout yet. NCT to confirm.

timeline.note: Phase 1b positive: significant PANSS reduction vs placebo. Generated the excitement behind AbbVie's ~$8.7B Cerevel acquisition. Exact readout date to confirm.

EMPOWER-1 & EMPOWER-2 (n=372) both MISSED the primary PANSS endpoint at week 6 vs placebo. AbbVie shares fell ~12%; ~$3.5B charge. AbbVie 'analyzing data to determine next steps' — schizophrenia program's future uncertain, not formally discontinued.

efficacy.comparator: vs placebo (statistically significant reduction; ~ -20 vs ~ -7, to confirm)
efficacy.note: Phase 1b positive (Nature Medicine 2022). Lower PANSS = improvement. Exact values to verify.

efficacy.note: Primary endpoint missed. Same endpoint as the Phase 1b row above — the signal did not replicate.
